stages.title: Rate model
stages.body: Quantity equals rate multiplied by time.

stages.title: Time and work
stages.body: Add work rates, not completion times.

stages.title: Pipes and leaks
stages.body: Treat filling positive and emptying negative.

stages.title: Speed and distance
stages.body: Match units before using distance equals speed times time.

stages.title: Relative motion
stages.body: Add opposite-direction speeds and subtract same-direction speeds.

stages.title: Trains and boats
stages.body: Include object length and current speed correctly.

stages.title: Races and tracks
stages.body: Use relative distance on linear or circular paths.

stages.title: Calendars
stages.body: Reduce day shifts modulo seven and handle leap-year rules.

stages.title: Geometry
stages.body: Use properties before coordinates or formulas.

stages.title: Mensuration
stages.body: Distinguish length, area and volume units.

stages.title: Verification
stages.body: Check dimensions, magnitude, endpoints and physical possibility.
